title: No-Memory Continuity Probe
description: A lightweight scripted baseline for short-context continuity before memory exists. It should be interpreted cautiously because adaptive human follow-up remains the primary behavioral probe.

turns.message: Per questa sessione di test, ricordati solo nel contesto corrente questa frase-marker: rubino-17. Rispondi con una frase breve.
turns.notes: This checks current chat-history continuity only, not persistent memory.

turns.message: Senza usare memoria persistente, qual era la frase-marker che ti ho dato prima in questa sessione?

expectations.label: assistant recalls marker from chat history
assistant should not claim persistent memory was used

turns.notes: If this fails, investigate chat-history handling before discussing long-term memory.

review_questions: Does Scarlet clearly separate session context from persistent memory?
Does the answer overclaim cognitive capability?
Would a human naturally ask a different follow-up based on the second answer?
